description: A Kivy application implementing an infinitely scrolling, constantly updating log view using RecycleView, with variable-sized widgets and scroll position management.

classes.name: FixedRecycleView
classes.description: Custom RecycleView subclass managing scroll position and distance tracking.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main Kivy App class that manages log data and UI building.

methods.name: add_log
methods.description: Appends a new log entry with timestamp and random text to the data list.

methods.name: update_size
methods.description: Updates cached size of a log entry for dynamic sizing.

methods.name: on_scrollable_distance
methods.description: Adjusts scroll position based on saved distance when scrollable distance changes.

methods.name: on_scroll_y
methods.description: Saves current scroll position as distance_to_top when scrolling occurs.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes the app UI and schedules periodic log updates.
